cases.name: secure_entry
cases.check: Trusted HTTPS certificate at the actual entry; no ATS exceptions; no credential redirects

cases.name: real_png_round_trip
cases.check: Upload from frontend, complete real cloud OMR, render all 17 bars, export MusicXML and MIDI

cases.name: real_pdf_all_pages
cases.check: Recognize both pages, show all 27 bars and all movements, verify MIDI and XML

cases.name: pitch_edit
cases.check: Change one pitched note in actual design editing UI, save revision, verify changed XML pitch and corresponding MIDI note events

cases.name: duration_edit
cases.check: Change note duration, save revision, verify XML duration and MIDI note length agree

cases.name: reload_saved
cases.check: Refresh app, reopen same job, preserve saved revision and edited note

cases.name: stale_revision
cases.check: Two editors save conflicting changes; second gets 409 and preserves unsaved local edits

cases.name: failed_edit_rollback
cases.check: Invalid MusicXML and failing MIDI conversion leave current revision, XML and MIDI unchanged

cases.name: revision_export_consistency
cases.check: If job changes during parallel downloads, mismatched ETags trigger re-fetch, never combining different revisions

cases.name: owner_authorization
cases.check: Different owner's guessed UUID cannot read, edit, export or inspect original/log; returns 404

cases.name: same_owner_devices
cases.check: Different authorized device credentials for same owner can access the same saved job

cases.name: credential_absence
cases.check: No administrator bearer or client device bearer embedded in generated bundle, source, URLs or logs

cases.name: origin_csrf
cases.check: Browser request from an untrusted origin or without required CSRF header cannot create/edit jobs

cases.name: offline_resume
cases.check: Once a job ID is saved, transient polling failure resumes query rather than re-uploading

cases.name: restart_persistence
cases.check: Restart only own service, retain job owner mapping, completed revision and exports

cases.name: iphone_orientation
cases.check: Compare actual frontend iPhone portrait/landscape proportions and layout with the supplied Figma reference

cases.name: ipad_orientation
cases.check: Compare actual frontend iPad portrait/landscape proportions and layout with the supplied Figma reference

cases.name: mac_layout
cases.check: Compare actual frontend Mac layout and resize rules with the supplied Figma reference

audio_integration_gate: Only begin actual listening-engine integration after layout comparison and real cloud OMR/editor acceptance have passed
